mapper.sql: run_id, mode, status, description, batch_size, last_movie_seq, last_tv_seq, last_cartoon_seq, batch_count, attempt_count, error_count, info_count, upserted_titles, upserted_credits, upserted_episodes, error_message, created_at, started_at, finished_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO migration_run (mode, description, batch_size) VALUES (#{mode}, #{description}, #{batchSize})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM migration_run ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT MAX(run_id) FROM migration_run WHERE mode = 'SYNC'
SELECT source_table, issue_type, severity, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM migration_issue WHERE run_id = #{runId} GROUP BY source_table, issue_type, severity ORDER BY source_table, severity, issue_type
SELECT source_table, source_count, target_count, missing_count, mismatch_count, orphan_count FROM migration_verify WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY source_table

SELECT r.run_id, r.finished_at, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, r.finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS age_minutes, SUM(v.missing_count) AS missing, SUM(v.mismatch_count) AS mismatch, SUM(v.orphan_count) AS orphan FROM migration_run r JOIN migration_verify v ON v.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT MAX(run_id) FROM migration_run WHERE mode = 'VERIFY' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY r.run_id, r.finished_at
